title: Isaiah 2 in the RSV pictures swords beaten into plowshares
summary: The RSV of Isaiah 2 says nations will beat swords into plowshares.
body: The Revised Standard Version of Isaiah 2 says that nations shall beat their swords into plowshares and not learn war any more. The verse is a vision in the book. It is not a record that the vision has already happened. The wording on the page includes: "4 He shall judge between the nations, and shall decide for many peoples; and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning hooks; nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.
